description: Run the standard quality passes over work just done — `/dry`, then `/tend-prose`, committing what they change, then `/five-percent`, posting its alternatives as a PR review — scoped to what the branch has changed since it was last polished. These are the passes `/go` runs at its Step 3; this skill is how work that never went through `/go` gets them. Invoke as `/polish [focus guidance]`, or `/polish full` to re-read the branch's whole diff against its base rather than only what it changed since the last polish commit. Use when the operator says "polish this", "tidy this up", or "run the checks that come after `/go`".
